summary: 1933 L-4 lookout cab near Enterprise, Oregon; lowered from its tower in the 1960s, abandoned in 1972; private land, no public access.

facts.design: L-4 cabin, first reported on a tower of 10 to 40 ft, later a ground cab

access.note: On private land; the register and firelookout.com both say the site is not open to the public.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1972 and on private land; the Oregon directory still counts it among standing lookouts.
facts.agency: US Forest Service - Wallowa-Whitman National Forest (per the register); firelookout.com and the Oregon directory describe private land

events.note: A forest lookout patrolman was stationed on Elk Mountain for the summer; this predates the 1933 build year
June 1932 newspaper: a 25 ft tower with a 14 by 14 house would be erected on Elk Mountain; not clear it is the 1933 tower
L-4 cabin on a tower, reported at 10 to 40 feet
Dale Hulse finishing the fire season on the lookout
Aug 4, 1966: lookout Billy Hunter reported a very large unidentified object; a check with the Federal Aviation Office in Baker later showed it was a balloon
Cab lowered from the tower to the ground before 1969 (firelookout.com); the register says sometime in the 1960s
Staffing ended and the cab was abandoned

notes_for_editor: County conflict: the register says Union County, firelookout.com says Wallowa County; the story keeps the firelookout.com wording and says the register places it in Union County. The 1966 object was identified as a balloon in the same clipping, and the story now says so. Early history unsettled: the 1928 patrolman item and firelookout.com's 1928 staff entry predate the 1933 build year, and the 1932 plan for a 25 ft tower with a 14x14 house may or may not be the 1933 tower. Record height is not used because the sources give 10 to 40 ft. Ownership conflict: the register lists USFS as administrator while firelookout.com and the directory describe private land; the agency field keeps the register wording with a note. Elevation: 5,127 ft (register) vs 5,122 ft (firelookout); the record's 1562.7 m matches the register. Register photo credit (Ray Kresek, 1993) noted but no image URL was found, so no photo added. Record status 'standing' kept; the cab is abandoned.
